applies_to: future policy version only; existing policy and rehearsal stay unchanged
rules: A block whose first local observation is a numbered day greater than 1 is structurally_left_censored.
A local 初日 anchor may resolve historical identity; it does not by itself prove prediction-time availability.
No meeting_id or meeting_day feature is materialized unless its prediction-time source and cutoff are independently proven.
Future schedule observations may not be used to make a target-time feature eligible.
